title: IntentContract
description: Schema for intent objects flowing through the voice engine. Produced by parser (local_exact/regex), fuzzyMatcher (local_fuzzy), or Gemini Function Calling (gemini).

skill.description: Target skill identifier matching a registered skill manifest.id.

action.description: Action to execute within the target skill.

params.description: Key-value parameters extracted from user speech.

confidence.description: Resolution confidence. >=0.95 execute, >=0.75 confirm, >=0.50 ask-repeat, <0.50 deny.

source.description: Resolution layer that produced this intent.
